mood.label: Bounce stalls
mood.summary: The early bounce has faded and the Nifty is back near Thursday's close. Breadth is roughly even: auto and private banks are up, while IT drags.

detail.laggards: IT (OFSS, Infosys, Mphasis, TCS); PB Fintech and NSE extend losses
detail.tone: The Nifty has given back the small gain from the 9:30 note and is hovering around 23,050, just below Thursday's 23,063 close. Advances and declines are nearly level, so there is no conviction either way.
